title: วันนี้กินเบา ๆ 3 ขวด... ตีสามหมดไป 3 ลัง
image_style: caricature illustration, exaggerated big heads and expressive faces, playful hand-drawn lines with soft painted shading, late-night palette of deep blue shadows and warm amber lamp light, no readable text, no logos, no brand labels on bottles
image_rules: Style is a 2D caricature illustration (not photorealistic). Two fictional Thai men in their late 20s, the same two characters in every image: friend A = short messy hair, black t-shirt; friend B = round glasses, white t-shirt. Keep faces and outfits consistent. Bottles and crates have no labels or readable text.

segments.text: [laughs] วันนี้... กินเบา ๆ นะ แค่ 3 ขวด
